title: Multiword Arithmetic and Parallel Computing
summary: In many applications, the precision by the available hardware arithmetic is insufficient to guarantee accurate results. Multiword arithmetic is a special type of multiprecision arithmetic where a multiple double is an unevaluated sum of 64-bit doubles, or where a multiple integer is an unevaluated sum of 64-bit integers. Parallel computing is applied to compensate for the cost overhead of multiword arithmetic.
